operations.name: All
operations.reference_behavior: An invocation enumerates current key/value pairs; yield False stops calls immediately.
operations.remaining: Lists are eager; pure folds do not stop their storage walk; effectful for-each returns Unit. No pair producer or effectful stop protocol. Mutable for-each snapshots differ from live deletion semantics.
required_future_fixtures: repeat same iterator after source mutation

operations.name: Clone
operations.reference_behavior: A shallow independent map preserving nil; keys and values are assigned, not recursively cloned.
existing_building_blocks: persistent Map/HashMap may safely share immutable structure
mutable to-list plus fresh from-list is a building block
operations.remaining: No named clone. Returning a mutable handle aliases its cells, so cannot implement clone. Rebuilding changes layout/order/capacity and requires key capabilities; non-reflexive entries must remain present. Nil has no base-map representation.

operations.name: Collect
operations.reference_behavior: Consume a pair sequence into a fresh allocated map; the last equal-key occurrence wins.
existing_building_blocks: persistent insert in a left fold is last-wins
Data.Producer is a pure pull-state building block
operations.remaining: No sequence consumer. map-from-pairs and hash-map-from-pairs are first-wins and are not direct equivalents. Existing Producer steps cannot perform arbitrary Mut/IO effects.

operations.name: Copy
operations.reference_behavior: Overwrite/add every source binding in an existing destination; source values win equal keys.
existing_building_blocks: map-union source destination returns the persistent result
hash-map-union source destination returns the persistent result
mutable source snapshot plus destination insert
operations.remaining: No mutable bulk-copy helper or cross-home adapter. Persistent return-value adaptation must be explicit. Snapshot self-copy safety must be specified, not assumed for non-reflexive keys. Nil destination cannot accept a nonempty source.
operations.reference_declaration: func Copy[$0 interface{ ~map[$2]$3 }, $1 interface{ ~map[$2]$3 }, $2 comparable, $3 interface{}]($0, $1)

operations.name: DeleteFunc
operations.reference_behavior: Call a key/value predicate and delete the current key when it returns True.
existing_building_blocks: map-filter with negated pure predicate returns a new map
hash-map-filter with negated pure predicate returns a new map
mutable snapshot plus key deletion is a restricted building block
operations.remaining: No mutable delete-where helper. Pure filter cannot run mutation callbacks. Snapshot predicates may observe entries already removed by earlier callbacks, unlike live iteration. Deleting a NaN key by lookup does not remove it under IEEE equality.
required_future_fixtures: NaN predicate True still fails key deletion

operations.name: Equal
operations.reference_behavior: Compare sizes, then corresponding key lookups and value equality; nil and empty compare equal.
existing_building_blocks: all homes expose size, lookup and entry traversal
operations.remaining: No map equality helper/instance. Pointer identity cannot shortcut equality: NaN keys/values can make a map unequal to itself. Equality across homes needs matching key equivalence and hash/order policies.

operations.name: EqualFunc
operations.reference_behavior: As Equal, with a supplied value predicate that may compare different value types; key equality is unchanged.
existing_building_blocks: all homes expose size, lookup and entry traversal
explicit feq-f32/feq-f64 can compare floating values
operations.remaining: No heterogeneously typed value-equality helper or effectful predicate variant. The supplied predicate does not replace key comparison. Strict existing folds cannot avoid all later storage reads, although predicates can be skipped after mismatch.

missing NaN key prevents value callback

operations.name: Insert
operations.reference_behavior: Consume pairs into an existing destination; later equal-key occurrences overwrite earlier values.
existing_building_blocks: all homes expose a single-binding insert
persistent left fold over Producer can return an updated map
operations.remaining: No public sequence/bulk-insert into an existing mutable map. A constructor creates a different map. Need explicit producer effects, ownership and self-derived sequence mutation policy.

operations.name: Keys
operations.reference_behavior: Repeated invocations enumerate current keys, stop on yield False, and do not promise order.
operations.remaining: All existing key views are eager lists. No map-specific lazy/reusable producer. Mutable capture-at-creation versus capture-at-invocation and live deletion behavior remain unresolved.

operations.name: Values
operations.reference_behavior: Repeated invocations enumerate current values, preserve duplicates, and stop on yield False.
operations.remaining: All existing value views are eager lists. No early-stop mutable sequence. Do not deduplicate values or pair independently obtained key/value views from an unstable-order map.

blocking_decisions: Live mutable iteration versus explicitly separate snapshot iteration, including unvisited deletions and early termination.
Effectful pair-source and predicate contracts; the existing Producer step and folds are pure.
Stable captured key equality/hash/order across operations; no stored policy authority exists in current handles.
Explicit IEEE non-reflexive floating keys versus reflexive key wrappers; no default F32/F64 Eq, Ord or Hash instances.
Nil represented only by an explicit Option adapter when observable; allocated empty remains the default map value.
